description: Use this when the user wants a Venn diagram of 2 or 3 lists or groups, for example "Venn diagram of these two customer lists" or "draw the overlap of skills for 3 candidates". Takes 2 or 3 named sets of items (up to 500 per set, 80 characters per item) or only region counts, a layout (symmetric, or proportional for 2 sets) and a case option. Returns the count of each region, which items are drawn, a check that each drawn label sits inside its region, an interactive diagram, and SVG, PDF and CSV downloads. Does not read files or images, and does not draw 4 or more sets. Lists are not kept after the call; download files of large diagrams are stored for 1 hour.

case_sensitive.description: false (default): "Apple" and "apple" are the same item. true: case matters.

layout.description: symmetric (default): circles of equal size, areas not to scale. proportional: 2 sets only, both with at least one item, circle and overlap areas to scale with the counts.

region_counts.description: Use when only the counts are known, not the items. Keys name one region each: 2 sets a, b, ab; 3 sets a, b, c, ab, ac, bc, abc (a = only the first set; ab = in the first and second set but not the third). Example: {"a":120,"b":80,"ab":45}.

set_names.description: Only with region_counts: the 2 or 3 set names in order a, b, c, e.g. ["Email","SMS"].

sets.description: 2 or 3 named lists to compare. Each set: {"name":"Team A","items":["Ann","Bo","Cy"]}. Names up to 40 characters; up to 500 items per set, each up to 80 characters. Give this or set_names with region_counts.

title.description: Diagram title, e.g. "Skills of two candidates". Up to 80 characters. Default: the set names joined with "vs".

name: make_venn
title: Make Venn diagram
